description: Steer agents to documentation instead of inferring behaviour from binaries (strings, otool, nm, objdump).

no-strings.description: strings(1) used to work out how a program behaves
no-strings.message: Don't work out how a program behaves from strings(1) on its binary: the output is unordered fragments without context and routinely misleads. Read its documentation instead: Context7 for libraries, frameworks and CLI tools, `<tool> --help`, `man <tool>`, or the upstream docs and source.

binary-spelunking.description: Symbol or disassembly dumps used for API discovery
binary-spelunking.message: If you are dumping symbols or disassembly to learn how to use a program or library, read its documentation instead (Context7, --help, man pages, upstream docs or source). Checking linkage or debugging a build is fine.

reverse-engineering.description: The user is deliberately analysing a binary's behaviour, not just learning how to use it
